The academy

Anaconda Jiu Jitsu Australia welcomes beginners and experienced grapplers.

In class, you’ll practise controlling position and pace before working towards a finish.

Meet the coaches

Classes

Brazilian Jiu Jitsu

Teens and adults, ages 13+

Train in a traditional Gi. Learn self-defence, striking and defence against strikes, throws, takedowns, and standing and ground grappling.

Separate beginner and intermediate or advanced classes give students room to develop at their level.

See Gi sessions

No Gi

Submission grappling

Combine wrestling and Brazilian Jiu Jitsu in shorts and a rashguard. The timetable includes advanced work, all-levels classes and rounds.

See No Gi sessions

Anaconda Kids

Ages 7–12

Kids train in a Gi and practise striking and defence, throws, takedowns and grappling. Sessions make room for games, teamwork, anti-bullying and “Tricky Adults” lessons.

Book a class

Coaches

Chris Boles

Head coach

BJJ black belt under Elvis Sinosic and Carlos Machado. Third Dan Taekwondo black belt. Leads the kids’ and adults’ BJJ programs.

Coaching & competition background

Chris has over two decades of martial arts experience. He has trained under or alongside Elvis Sinosic, Sean Kirkwood, John B Will, John Danaher, Lachlan Giles, Craig Jones, Bruno Malficine, Caio Terra, Eddie Bravo, and Carlos, Rigan and Jean Jacques Machado.

His competition record includes NSW black-belt state titles in striking and grappling, a NSW Masters Black Belt No Gi title in July 2022, and multiple Will/Machado Australasian gold medals. He has competed and won in BJJ at every belt level.

Ben Lovett

Lead Gi coach

Black belt Ben Lovett teaches Gi on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.

Mike Stevenson

Lead No Gi coach

Black belt Mike Stevenson teaches No Gi on Monday and Wednesday evenings.

Inside the academy

Our full-time academy at The Doylo has a purpose-built 180 m² training area. The floor pairs a 40 mm EVA base with 40 mm tatami judo mats.

The studio is well lit, with air conditioning, two large fans and a roller door for ventilation. Members have access to separate men’s, women’s and accessible toilets, change rooms and showers. There are more than 100 car spaces on site.

Your first class

Kids train in a supervised setting that encourages confidence, respect and teamwork. Teens and adults can work on fitness, self-defence or competition skills through technique, sparring and conditioning.

The academy advertises four weeks of free training for new members joining a full membership. Call to confirm the limited-time offer.
